svg.title: iOS · Interval grading viewer · keyframed · landscape
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift's rail layout (`railBody`, `controlRail`, `railEditorStack`) on a landscape iPhone with App/GradeTimelineView.swift under the pane and App/PhotoAdjustmentsPanel.swift (layout .rail, style .dark) in the rail — an INTERVAL shoot in the keyframed sunset scenario. Redrawn 2026-09-13 for the editor controls redesign (board 6c's placement on the dark rail). The scrubber belongs to the MEDIA, so it takes the media column's width rather than the rail's — which keeps the rail identical to the photo editor's and the whole photo/interval difference to one component. THE RAIL LAYOUT (`railBody` + `controlRail` + `railEditorStack`, `EditorLayout.rail`): taken by a landscape iPhone, a wide split and iPad portrait (settled 2026-09-13: wide enough for a rail, too tall for the sheet to reach the picture) — and by the Mac, whose rail is the light board 3b; on iOS the same rail is forced dark. Rail width = min(340, 0.42 × width) of the SAFE width — 734 pt on this canvas (59 pt insets either side) gives 308.3, so the media column is 425.4 pt from x = 59 and the rail runs 484.7…793 with its content inset 16 (276.3 pt wide; the iPhone 16 Pro simulator, at 750 pt safe, measured a 315 pt rail with 288 pt of content). The whole rail scrolls, tab pill included, padded 14 top / 16 sides / 20 bottom with 12 pt between cards: (1) `RailTabBar` — NOT the over-picture pill — a 36 pt LL.cardBackground capsule, padding 3, four equal 13 pt semibold segments padded 7, amber on ink with the selected one amber and black; (2) `EditorGroupBar(.macCard)` drawn dark: a radius-12 card padded 6 holding six 46 pt cells (SF Symbol 18 pt, 9.5 pt semibold label, 4 pt dot; the open group amber on amber 14 %, the rest #8E8E93) — the buttons STAY visible here, the sheet does not cover them, and on this rail the six cells (276 pt) overrun the card's 6 pt padding and sit flush with its edges; (3) the open group's `PhotoAdjustmentsPanel(layout: .rail, style: .dark)`: a radius-12 card padded 12 with the phone sheet's own header (15 pt title, dot, ✕ white 10 %, ✓ amber), chips, pad (170 pt) and readouts — at 252 pt of card content the three chips are 80 pt each, and 'Exp · Con' plus its icon and diamond does not fit: the label shrinks to 0.75 and then truncates to 'Exp ·…', 'High ·…', 'Shad ·…' (⚠️ noted in INDEX.md); (4) the Masks card (`MasksCard`, 'Masks · + Add' when the project has none); (5) the inline save offer where the project is Edited. 'Reset adjustments' is Mac-only (spec §3); on iOS the resets live under a long-press on the panel title. No marquee badge over the picture (`railMarqueeBadge` is macOS-only). The back disc floats top-leading of the pane (`chrome`, 16 / 12 padding); the 1:1 toggle bottom-trailing, 12 pt in, while `hasPixelsToReveal`. The picture fills the column's height or width, centred; the home indicator (21 pt safe inset) is the only bottom inset, so the rail's foot and the strip run to y = 372. THE STRIP (6c, `railBody` on the Editor page): a 54 pt row under the pane, padded 6 above and 16 at the sides, on the COMPACT metrics — 26 pt play disc (#1C1C1E, amber play.fill), 12 pt gap, the 3 pt rail at white 18 %, 11 pt amber moments with the 2 pt #C36A00 ring at 10 / 52 / 86 %, a 3×20 white playhead at 30 % under them, the 16 pt elapsed bubble ('0:40:12', held between 7 % and 93 %) with its foot over the playhead's head, 10 pt #8E8E93 clocks under the rail's ends, and the 26 pt one-frame steps ‹ › 6 pt apart after the track, centred on the strip's whole height (transport + labels), 7 pt below the play disc; the steps take their width out of the track. Drawn with the playhead between the first two moments (not snapped — a snapped moment swells to 15 pt with a white ring inside a #C36A00 halo, and the pads then edit that moment). THE PANEL: the chips carry the diamond on Exp · Con and High · Wh (exposure and highlights travel), the pad's knob is at the blended value (exposure −0.09 at 30 %, 1.5 pt under the crosshair); its readouts ('Exposure ◆ -0.09 · Contrast 0') and the Masks card are under the fold. The hook also keyframes shadows, vibrance and the white, so a screenshot shows a third diamond on Shad · Bl. Staged by LL_EDITOR=latest LL_VIEWER=1 LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=light:expcon in landscape (Device ▸ Rotate Left, orientation read back; capture iphone-land-light-expcon.png — its project happened to be a 16:9 Charles Bridge shoot with a 265 h clock; the boards' 2 h 14 min clocks are kept).
